description: Run vercel-env-hygiene with VERCEL_TOKEN (a project-scoped token is enough) and VERCEL_PROJECT_ID from this server's environment, or the project id passed here. Reports secret-looking variables exposed to the browser through a NEXT_PUBLIC_ or VITE_ prefix, test keys in production, and production values missing from preview. The token is trimmed, sent only to api.vercel.com, and never appears in the output. Variable values are fetched only when SECUREALY_VERCEL_DECRYPT=1 is set in the environment; without it the checks that need values (trailing newlines, live keys outside production) are reported as skipped and only names and targets are read.

projectId.description: Vercel project id (prj_...). Falls back to VERCEL_PROJECT_ID or .vercel/project.json in the working directory.

name: check_vercel_env
title: Check Vercel environment hygiene
